title: chore(ui-tooling): drop two test-only scripts and six CLI aliases nothing runs (slice 2 of #25920)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D7sHdFfY8QjwRsxKSLngGfv)_

Part of #25920 — slice 2 of the unwired-tooling cleanup (slice 1 was #26004). The card stays open for the slices listed at the end.

## Summary

Deletions only: 7 files, −1,322 lines, on `main` 88531fab.

- `ui/scripts/coverage-red-cause-census.mjs` + `coverage-red-cause-suspects.json` + its test → **delete.** Its header calls it "a ONE-OFF CENSUS, not a gate … nothing in CI calls it"; nothing but its test and one `markdown-test-inputs.mjs` row named it (row removed).
- `ui/scripts/extract-mdx-demos.mjs` + its test → **delete.** A one-off MDX-to-schema-catalog migration helper; no alias, no workflow; nothing but its test and one `markdown-test-inputs.mjs` row named it (row removed).
- `ui/package.json` aliases `cli`, `objectui`, `doctor`, `studio`, `generate`, `g` → **delete.** All six point at `packages/cli/dist/cli.js`; no workflow, script or document runs any of them (exact `pnpm NAME` / `pnpm run NAME` grep over the whole tree: 0 hits; the `objectui:build` / `objectui:refresh` hits are different root scripts).

Corrections to the #26004 body's "remaining slices" table, kept out of this PR on purpose:

- `test:unit` and `test:integration` **stay**: `ui/scripts/__tests__/package-scripts-vitest-projects.test.ts` pins both against the vitest projects.
- `start` and `site:start` **stay**: both targets exist (`@object-ui/console` `preview`, `@object-ui/site` `start`) and `ui/apps/console/README.md` documents `pnpm start`.
- `check` **stays**: root `ci.yml` runs `pnpm --dir ui run check`.

Nothing is wired.

## Verification (head e1651b46)

- Exact-name `git grep` across the whole tree (AGENTS.md, skills, .claude, docs, every manifest, CHANGELOGs excluded) for both scripts, the ledger and the six aliases: no hits outside the deleted files and the two removed rows. No governed text touched.
- ui suites that read the scripts inventory and manifest (markdown-test-inputs, package-scripts-vitest-projects, check-unreferenced-sources, ci-cd-pipeline-doc, vitest-invocation-guard): 5 files, 200 tests passed. `pnpm --dir ui run check:unreferenced-sources` exit 0, `check:test-path-roots` exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived families: see the report on the card for the per-family exit codes.
- No changeset: private ui tooling and the private ui root manifest only.

## Remaining slices

- One report-only census per PR: `tsconfig-test-parity-census` (430 lines plus ~10 pointer comments), `page-key-read-census` (1,146), `dollar-dialect-alias-census` (1,109), `check-component-surface-parity` (2,584), `changeset-polarity-census` (3,525, split in two to stay under the 3,000-line human-merge threshold).
- Then the mechanical tsconfig dedupe.
- The eight gate-shaped scripts listed on #26004 stay for a maintainer wire-or-delete ruling.
